signature.name: VTask.prod
signature.type: {ι : Type u} -> {γ : Type w} -> {β : ι → Type v} -> [DecidableEq ι] -> [(i : ι) → Zero (β i)] -> [(i : ι) → (x : β i) → Decidable (x ≠ 0)] -> [CommMonoid γ] -> (f : Π₀ (i : ι), β i) -> (g : (i : ι) → β i → γ) -> γ

conventions.statement: When f = 0 (empty support), VTask.prod f g = 1 (empty product).
conventions.note: Standard empty product convention in a CommMonoid.

conventions.statement: Indices i where f i = 0 do not contribute any factor to the product; only i ∈ f.support are included.
conventions.note: Defines the meaning of 'product over the support'.

conventions.statement: If g i 0 = 1 for all i in an extended set s ⊇ f.support, then VTask.prod f g = ∏ i ∈ s, g i (f i).
conventions.note: Extra terms evaluate to 1 and do not change the product.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {γ : Type*} {β : ι → Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [inst1 : (i : ι) → Zero (β i)] [inst2 : (i : ι) → (x : β i) → Decidable (x ≠ 0)] [CommMonoid γ] {i : ι} {b : β i} {g : (i : ι) → β i → γ}, g i 0 = 1 → VTask.prod (DFinsupp.single i b) g = g i b
